messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: kv-cache memory pressure high on serving-cluster-3 (p95 mem usage 89%, evictions increasing). Trigger: continuous-batching throughput spike. Incident created 2034567890.

ashwin (oncall): seeing huge KV cache growth after the latest batch-config experiment ramped to 30%. Evict rate +120% over baseline. Affected: /v1/generate on cluster-3, a few customers reporting latency spikes. Paging SRE.

jen (sre): looking. Can you dump recent metric windows? runbook step 1 (check evictions, paging) in progress.

maria (eng-runtime): copying logs from canary: ```
[2026-03-15T10:04:11Z] batcher: continuous_batching::apply batch_size=64 prefix_cached=false kv_cache_size=1.8GB
[2026-03-15T10:04:12Z] kv::insert key_count=24321 mem_delta=+450MB
[2026-03-15T10:04:13Z] eviction: background_evict triggered, items=1200, latency=183ms
``` Seems like longer sequences + larger batch window created many prefix entries.

ashwin (oncall): customer-sarah from support says Customer Acorn (top-10 revenue) experiencing >500ms added latency and 5% request errors. We should apply per-customer throttle or disable continuous batching for them immediately.

scott (product): prioritize preserving Acorn. If per-customer override exists, toggle it. Also want quick note for sales.

maria (eng-runtime): we have a feature-flag endpoint. Plan: 1) set batch_config.continuous_batching=false for tenant=acorn 2) roll canary back from 30% -> 5% globally 3) monitor evictions and mem. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN' \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/acorn/feature-batch-config \
  -d '{"continuous_batching": false}'
```
I'll run step 1 now.

maria (eng-runtime): toggle done. Response: `{\"status\":\"ok\",\"tenant\":\"acorn\"}`. Confirming Acorn requests are now routed with batch window=legacy.

jen (sre): good. I'm lowering the canary percentage in the rollout controller. Patch: ```yaml
rollout:
  name: batch-config-hf
  target_percent: 5
``` Applying.

ashwin (oncall): applied. Canary now 5%. Watching evictions and p95 latency.

incident-bot: Event: rollout.updated by maria (eng-runtime) at 2034567922.

jen (sre): initial numbers: evictions down 42% in cluster-3 over the 3m window, mem growth slowed. Acorn latency back to baseline (p95 delta -10ms). No new 5xx from Acorn.

ashwin (oncall): good. Any customers still impacted? customer-sarah: says a second customer (Minerva) has intermittent spikes but not as bad.

maria (eng-runtime): Minerva is on the 5% canary group. I'll flip per-tenant toggle for Minerva too while we stabilize.

maria (eng-runtime): Minerva toggle done. Command used: `curl .../tenants/minerva/feature-batch-config -d '{"continuous_batching": false}'` (internal ops token).

jen (sre): metrics show cluster-wide evictions down 58% and background GC latency normalized. Recommendation: keep canary at 5% for 30m, then consider a 2-step config: reduced batch_size + prefix-cache TTL to limit kv growth.

scott (product): agree. Can we ship a targeted hotfix that adjusts batch_size from 64->32 and sets prefix_ttl=10m for the next rollout? Also want a short note for sales/support about Acorn and Minerva being protected.

maria (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR with the hotfix config and attach perf tests. Quick patch commands: ```yaml
batch_config:
  continuous_batching: true
  batch_size: 32
  prefix_ttl_seconds: 600
```
I'll stage it to canary at 5% first.

jen (sre): sounds good. Keep per-tenant overrides for top customers until we validate. Oncall: keep monitoring for 30m and escalate if evictions or 5xx climb.

ashwin (oncall): will monitor. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-514 in Jira and tagging EngRuntime/SRE/Support. Noting mitigation done: per-tenant toggles (Acorn, Minerva) + global canary reduced to 5%.

customer-sarah (support): I've emailed Acorn's CSM and added a short status update: 'We applied a protective toggle for your traffic, performance normalized, we're rolling a config hotfix, will follow up in 1 hour.'

incident-bot: Status changed -> mitigation_in_progress. Next check-in scheduled 2034568020 (approx 10m).

ashwin (oncall): leaving a handoff to daytime SRE @jen for follow-up in next shift. If anything regresses, revert canary to 0% and maintain per-tenant toggles.

jen (sre): acknowledged, taking over. I'll coordinate the PR validation and canary progression plan.

maria (eng-runtime): PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/1248 with perf runs attached. Will wait for SRE thumbs before ramping.

scott (product): thanks team. Will prepare a short blameless postmortem note once stable.

ashwin (oncall): closing paging loop for now. I'll update INC-2026-514 with timelines.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-514 updated: mitigations applied, assigned to jen (sre).
